South Sudan President Dissolves Government Ahead of Elections

South Sudan's President Salva Kiir has dissolved the government ahead of the country's first national elections scheduled for December. This move is intended to clear hurdles for the delayed election. However, it has also raised concerns that the president may now wield unchecked power.
